steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I remember <color=#fb9259>Segal</color>, the Undergrounder. She was the only one who managed to consistently evade HUSH during the whole chase. According to the reports, she's either mastered some kind of <color=#fb9259>spatial powers</color> or she's tapped into the Underground Mania magic.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: That's your reward for taking on this mission, right? Once the mission's complete, she'll show you how to perfectly conceal the Garden.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Feel free to guess, but even if you guessed it, you're incapable of deciphering the arcane arts of the Underground. Otherwise, you wouldn't have been groping in the dark for years, failing to even locate the entrance. Losers！

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You're right, Paradeisos doesn't have the same mastery over Mania as the Underground, making it impossible for them to locate the Garden. Besides, your Blooms have all become experts at concealment.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Within the finite life you have, you've gone to great lengths to pave their path. Mentor, you possess a finesse and a softer side that's even greater than you realize—truly commendable.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Tsk, you make me sick. I only act in my own interest. I accepted this Garden because they're good at serving me—it pleases me.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You're right, they do love you very much, even more profoundly than you realize.
Hearing those words, Coquelic gets goosebumps all over. In an instant, her crystalline weapon, forged from the essence of countless fallen foes, is shattered by a piercing beam of blue light.

The attack comes from Schorl, glowing ominously, adjacent to the Sinner Shalom. It unfurls its form and gracefully floats to the battlefield's core. Rahu has retreated, lifting her shields to protect Shalom.

Coquelic recalls the devastating potency of its assault against Mania. During the abduction episode, its unexpected celestial downpour obliterated an entire truck filled with Underground Mania Bombs. For the Sinners, this entity is nothing short of Paradeisos's man-made God of Death.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>Your foresight was spot-on; the Underground has indeed nurtured a perilous Sinner. It's no wonder that Paradeisos has struggled to eradicate her for so long.</color>

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>However, her vitality has been severely drained by Mania; her sluggish movements pose little threat.</color>

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>Eliminate her, X. For the sake of your mission, you must remove any chance of Underground interference.</color>

Shalom looks beyond the God of Death, fixing her gaze on the targeted Coquelic. Unwavering before Schorl, she has already unsheathed a new floral sword. She must have amassed considerable power for this odyssey.
You're all underestimating her... She's not indecisive; her subconscious is actively seeking a way to cheat death. She aspires to meet her end elsewhere.
But that won't work, Coquelic... Unleash your full power, or your blossom will be crushed before it even blooms.
Shalom clenches the petals in her hand and starts to speak softly.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: In Erica Villa, merely mentioning you makes Garofano barge in without a second thought. Out of all the misinformation we've provided, she's most intrigued by the technology that enables control over Mania to help extend lifespan.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Your flowers must be growing increasingly anxious. Did you fill them in on this details of this mission? When was the last time you went back and saw them?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: It's been long enough that the mere trickle of information I released about you sent eager young fools rushing to investigate...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Are these...?
Shalom pulls a few blue crystal flowers from her pocket: Violet, Carnation, Chrysanthemum, Lily.
As Coquelic catches sight of them, her eyes narrow instantly. Shalom smiles, savoring every nuance of Coquelic's reaction.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You know, they want to protect you just as much.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I have my regrets, but you've accumulated too many enemies on this path. Once the order reached me, there was no turning back.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You can't shield them alone, not forever. Some things are simply fated.
What will the Garden's Master do next, and to what extent can she act...
